metadata.description: Agent skills for Linear Haskell and the pure-borrow library

plugins.name: linear-haskell
plugins.description: Skill for writing, reviewing, and debugging Linear Haskell (GHC LinearTypes and linear-base) on GHC 9.10.3 and 9.12.4+.

plugins.name: pure-borrow
plugins.description: Skill for Rust-style borrowing in Linear Haskell with the pure-borrow library: BO monad, lifetimes, Mut/Share/Lend borrows, and pure parallelism. Install together with linear-haskell.
